raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The v2 card collector, rolling out since 2026-01-16, emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy emits America/Chicago local time (UTC-6 in January). The pipeline casts both as-is, so v2 rows land 6 hours late: evening transactions show up at 00:00-06:00 and spill into 2026-01-19. Converting v2 timestamps to Chicago local time makes them consistent with legacy, and the sample v2 rows at 12:00 UTC map to 06:00 local, matching opening hours.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
